list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: Will it leave patches on clothes?
list.content: No, if you allow the product to absorb before wearing clothes, it won't leave patches.

list.title: Can I use it directly post-waxing?
list.content: We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use this deodrant post waxing.

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

list.title: What is the Use of Underarm Roll-on?
list.content: Underarm roll-on is a personal care product that controls body odour and keeps underarms clean and fresh. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women is specifically designed to provide freedom from smelly underarms with pigmentation. It helps mask the odour, keeps underarms clean and healthy, and reduces pigmentation over time.

list.title: Does Roll-on Lighten Underarms?
list.content: Yes, roll-ons can help to lighten underarms. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women, for example, is specifically designed to reduce pigmentation over time. The product contains 2% Lactic Acid, which exfoliates dead skin cells and helps to fade pigmentation. Additionally, the 1% Mandelic Acid and Alpha Arbutin in the roll-on seep under the skin and slow down melanin production from within, which can also help to lighten underarms.

list.title: Does Underarm Roll-on Stop Sweat?
list.content: Underarm roll-ons are not designed to stop sweating completely. However, they can help to control sweating and reduce excessive perspiration. The 1% Salicylic Acid in the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women helps to kill sweat-causing bacteria, which can help to mask odour and keep underarms fresh. The roll-on also contains ingredients such as Shea Butter and Aloe Vera, which help to soothe and moisturise the skin, making it less prone to irritation and sweating.

list.title: What Are the Side Effects of Roll-on?
list.content: The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women is made with gentle and safe ingredients that are unlikely to cause any side effects when used as directed. It is free from harsh chemicals, fragrances, and alcohol, which are common irritants that can cause skin dryness, itching, and redness. The roll-on is formulated to be non-sticky and non-greasy, which makes it comfortable to wear throughout the day.

list.title: What is the Use of Underarm Roll-on for Ladies?
list.content: Ladies' underarm roll-ons are intended to provide long-lasting sweat and odour protection while also improving the overall health and appearance of the underarms. For example, the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women contains a blend of ingredients like Salicylic Acid, Lactic Acid, Mandelic Acid, and Alpha Arbutin, which help to exfoliate dead skin cells, reduce pigmentation, and slow down melanin production from within.  Furthermore, moisturising ingredients like Shea Butter and Aloe Vera help to soothe and nourish the skin, making it less prone to irritation and discomfort. Underarm roll-ons can help to control excessive sweating, mask odour, and promote healthy, even-toned underarms when used regularly.

list.title: Can We Apply Roll-on After Shaving Underarms?
list.content: Applying underarm roll-on after shaving is generally safe, but it is important to wait a few minutes after shaving to allow the skin to heal and avoid irritation. Shaving can cause small cuts and abrasions on the skin, increasing the risk of irritation and infection. Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on.
